_authority: This file is the authority on where a course's files live and how they reach a tablet. tablet/GUIDE.md points at it and must not restate the paths in prose.

architecture.chosen: one app, courses as data packs
architecture.rule: The two terminals are ONE codebase. A new course adds a content folder and one registry entry. It never adds app code, never forks a terminal, and never changes a shared engine.
why: The owner's requirement is that every course has the SAME UX. Shared code is the only thing that actually enforces that; a copied terminal drifts the first time one course is fixed.
A shared fix reaches every course at once. With one APK per course it has to be applied N times and one will be missed.
It keeps the offline guarantee: a data pack is files, so nothing needs a network at class time.

rejected.separate APK per course: UX drifts between courses and a shared fix must be applied N times
rejected.tablets pull at runtime: needs the tablets online in a classroom; the terminals are deliberately offline-capable

source_of_truth.rule: The Android project is authoritative. Any Desktop copy of the terminals is a working area, not a source, and diverges silently.

build_flavours.consequence: Gradle merges the source sets into ONE asset root, so at runtime the two terminals are SIBLINGS. A cross-terminal link is written relative to that merged root and is unresolvable in the split source tree - which makes a correct link look broken. Verify links against a merged view, never against one source set.

course_pack._note: One folder per course, self-contained. Paths below are relative to the trainee asset root.
required: course.json            registry entry - id, title, modules, academic_hour_min, programme source
module_NN/index.html   the one-page module - open, Start, Next to the end
module_NN/tasks/       trainee task pages announced by that module's screens
module_NN/assets/      that module's photos and figures, with _photo_meta.json
handout/index.html     the trainee's take-home, and the overflow valve for the hours
assessment/            the final assessment, separate from every module check
optional: module_NN/documents/   reference cards a trainee keeps
module_NN/simulator/   simulator briefs where a simulator is used
rules: A course pack never reaches outside itself except to the shared engines.
Shared engines (gb_*.js, gb_*.css) live once at the terminal root and are NEVER copied into a course pack - a copy goes stale the first time the engine is fixed.
Every photo carries a licence and credit in _photo_meta.json, and the file is opened and looked at before use.

per_course: it_run.js        GENERATED from the decks' own markup - never hand-edited
plans/           one Advanced module plan per module, stating its allocated and built minutes
prepare/         pre-class setup for modules whose practical needs a facility booked
record/          the practical skills record - the only copy, and nothing backs it up

generated_files.rule: A generated file carries DO NOT HAND-EDIT in its header and is regenerated after ANY deck change. Slide numbers move whenever a deck is cut, and a stale number lies silently.

it_run.js.from: each deck's <section class="slide"> order plus data-kind / data-activity / data-title / data-cue
it_run.js.overrides: Anything the generator cannot derive goes in an OVERRIDES table INSIDE the generator, checked on every run, never hand-edited into the output. A rotted override must stop the run rather than ship a wrong slide number.

offline.rule: A classroom tablet may have no network. Nothing at class time may depend on one.
checks: no CDN script, style or font that the page needs in order to be readable
web fonts: bundle the files and declare @font-face, or accept the system fallback deliberately - every stack must end in a generic family so the degradation is chosen, not arbitrary
no runtime fetch that gates content
offline.known_gap: GAS BASIC pulls Raleway from Google Fonts on 105 pages with no bundled copy. All three stacks end in sans-serif so it degrades gracefully, but the brand typeface is lost offline.

git.rule: The owner commits and pushes. Never commit or push on their behalf; stage only when asked.
before_handover: every NEW file staged - an untracked asset ships as a missing file and the failure appears only on the tablet
no .bak, .orig or editor state inside an asset tree - it is packaged into the APK
scan every staged file for credentials before a push: PEM blocks, service-account JSON, service_role keys, hardcoded passwords. Secrets belong in the platform's env, never in the repo.
git.diff_hygiene: Compare `git diff -U0 | grep -c '^[-+]'` with the same under --ignore-all-space. A large gap means an edit reformatted files it was not asked to touch - fix that before handover.

verification_order: hours/scripts/check_hours.py        minutes are 1:1 with the programme
tablet/scripts/verify_links.py      every link resolves in the MERGED asset root
tablet/scripts/crosscheck_tasks.py  deck <-> run script <-> tablet manifest agree
course-module-ux measurement lane   the screens themselves, at every delivery size
